title: Result Clauses: tan … que, tanto … que, de tal manera que
goal: Say how much or in what way something led to a result with tan … que, tanto … que, de tal manera que and de tal modo que.
grammar: tan … que, tanto … que, de tal manera que, de tal modo que

items: I can say a result with *tan* … *que* and *tanto* … *que*.
I can use *de tal manera que* and *de tal modo que* for the way something was done.
I can use the indicative after them for a real result.
